description: Hand-editable curated list of macro-relevant Polymarket markets for the Asymmetry Hunter Polymarket-divergence component (g). Each market is fetched from the free public Gamma API by slug; 'data_stance' links it to a Phase 1 signal so the Hunter can measure the gap between the crowd's implied probability and our own data-implied stance. Markets with data_stance=null still get daily snapshots + velocity (no divergence vote). yes_means documents what the 'Yes' outcome represents. Add/remove markets freely; the loader skips anything it cannot fetch.

markets.question: Fed cuts rates at the next FOMC meeting?
